title: Domestic AI Rises to the Top Globally! MiniMax H3 Leads Open-Source Community, Ecological and Capital Sectors Surge Strongly

content_html:
Recently, MiniMax officially open-sourced its new general-purpose multimodal generation model MiniMax H3. Upon its release, it caused a strong reaction in the domestic and international AI community. The model not only ranked first in multiple authoritative evaluation rankings worldwide but also strongly climbed to the top of the popularity list on the open-source community Hugging Face, demonstrating China's solid strength in extending open-source AI to the multimodal field.

Within 24 hours after the model's release, more than a hundred domestic and foreign partners have completed the adaptation and access of MiniMax H3, showing remarkable ecological explosive power. Industry analysts pointed out that the focus of global large model competition is rapidly shifting from pure technical indicators to comprehensive ecological capabilities, and the efficiency of hardware and chip adaptation has become the core standard for measuring ecological maturity.

The outstanding performance of MiniMax H3 has also won high praise from the capital market. Several mainstream investment banks quickly reaffirmed their "buy" rating for MiniMax, all believing that the launch of H3 further solidifies its leading position in the AI video generation sector, significantly enhancing its commercialization and customer expansion capabilities. Benefiting from this positive news, MiniMax's stock price experienced a strong increase, closing with a single-day rise of over 10% as of the 5th.

content_html_zh:
近日，MiniMax正式开源其全新通用多模联运一代车型MiniMax H3。 一经发布，在国内外人工智能界引起强烈反响。 该模型不仅在全球多项权威评测排名中位列第一，还强势登上开源社区Hugging Face热度榜榜首，展现了中国将开源人工智能延伸到多模态领域的雄厚实力。

模型发布后24小时内，已有百余家国内外合作伙伴完成MiniMax H3的适配和接入，展现出非凡的生态爆发力。 业内分析人士指出，全球大模型竞争的焦点正迅速从单纯的技术指标转向综合生态能力，硬件和芯片适配效率成为衡量生态成熟度的核心标准。

MiniMax H3的出色表现也赢得了资本市场的高度赞誉。 多家主流投行迅速重申了对MiniMax的“买入”评级，均认为H3的推出进一步巩固了其在AI视频生成领域的领先地位，显着增强了其商业化和客户拓展能力。 受益于这一利好消息，MiniMax股价强势上涨，截至5日收盘单日涨幅超10%。
